meaning:
ἐπι-ποθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for יָאַב, אָרַג, כָּסַף hi., etc. ;]
to long for, desire: with inf., Rom.1:11, 2Co.5:2, 1Th.3:6, 2Ti.1:4, Php.2:26 (WH, [txt.]); with accusative of thing(s), 1Pe.2:2; with accusative of person(s), 2Co.9:14, Php.1:8 2:26 (WH, mg); absol., Jas.4:5 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;
For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,
For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see…
longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
